## d40a839c7d8b

Inspected selected generator SHA-256 `c280887166f87ab76d450d737548b3a27a75f315ebb672a55de211d310d0660c`; canonical rule hash `c7049cdbce74`. The audit target source was not edited.

**D40-A1 — Reproduced semantic defect: a three-demo lesson leaves the height-parity rival alive.** The strict semantic gate materialized 12 Racket-labelled lessons (three demonstrations plus the next generated pair as query): 10/12 were identifiable, while one medium and one hard lesson failed. Exact medium replay: `band=medium`, `seed=256453378305694`, `sample_index=33`. Its three demos are 3×13, 8×14, and 5×11; in each, `(height+1)%2 == (width+1)%2`, so “derive the recolored column parity from height” exactly matches all three labels. The 3×12 query has width trigger 1 but height trigger 0, so the rival differs from the canonical answer in 12 cells. The query passes `self_check`; public `arcpuzzles apply` executes rule `c7049cdbce74`, exactly matches the retained gate label (output SHA-256 `67f838823d5f594870e857323ce22d7c90a50aa46842b3973130f873f22d0ef0`), and disagrees with the rival (SHA-256 `8635e60752c8f7bb27f517aa4fcd736bc507cb32cd5b9d32944dde06aa063c7f`). Evidence: `checks/audit/d40a839c7d8b/reproducer/` and `checks/audit/d40a839c7d8b/checks/d40a839c7d8b_audit_semantic_gate.json`. Repair the schedule so every production three-demo window includes at least one example where height- and width-derived trigger parity disagree; expose the competitor publicly as `LESSON_COMPETITORS` so survivor reports name it directly.

**D40-A2 — Reproduced portable-test defect.** The audit preset’s task-test preflight failed before pytest: `tests/test_generator_d40a839c7d8b.py` sets `ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]`, then looks for `data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl` beneath the staged task directory. That path does not exist in the portable runtime. Evidence: `checks/audit/d40a839c7d8b.controller.log` and `checks/audit/d40a839c7d8b/checks/d40a839c7d8b_audit_summary.json`. Replace fixed parent-depth assumptions and private per-puzzle imports with `reviewer_support.find_root(__file__)`, `canonical_path`/`canonical_pairs`, and `load_selected_generator`.
